title: Land's End Beach
wikitext:
[[Image:Land's End Beach.jpg|thumb|Land's End Beach]]

'''Land's End Beach''' is the most southern point of the [[Tanaris Desert]]{{coords|60|88|Tanaris}}, in the far Southeastern tip of [[Kalimdor]]. It is located at an abandoned piece of coastline which is only reachable by sea. Besides a crashed [[flying machine]] and some wood sticking out of the sand, there are {{mob|Surf Glider}}s that range from 48 to 50, and are quite aggressive.

If you look into the distance at the most southern point, you will see a [[South Seas islands|mysterious island]], which you cannot reach by swimming without tricks or completing the quest given by [[Meridith the Mermaiden]]. With [[water walking]] granted by a [[shaman]] or an {{item|Elixir of Water Walking}}, as a [[death knight]] with [[Unholy Presence]] and [[Path of Frost]] activated, or as a [[druid]] with the {{item|Glyph of Aquatic Form}}, you can reach the island to find some empty goblin structures and several [[Southsea Freebooter]]s wandering about. 

This was once believed to be an undeveloped [[Undermine]], the [[goblin]] city of much importance in lore, but now (as of [[Patch 1.8 (Release Notes)|patch 1.8]]) believed to be the [[South Seas islands]] included in [[the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain]].

==Inspiration==
This [[subzone]] is ''possibly'' a reference to [[Wikipedia:Land's End|Land's End]] in England, the southwestern tip of the British mainland.
